title: Oozing Moroccan Chicken Couscous Royal
description: A winey, fluffy solo dinner featuring braised chicken sweetened with dark brown soft sugar, served over fluffy couscous on a tagliere platter, low-fat friendly and bursting with Moroccan spices.
instructions: Pat the chicken breasts dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon, ginger, and a pinch of sugar.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken for 3 minutes per side until golden brown; remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the wine, deglaze by scraping brown bits, and let it reduce by half, about 2 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet, pour in the broth, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes or until the chicken reaches 74C internal temperature.
While the chicken braises, prepare couscous by sprinkling it on a heatproof dish, pouring 1 cup of hot water or broth, covering, and letting it steam for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork.
Slit the cooked chicken and drizzle the braising liquid over it, then transfer everything onto a tagliere platter.
Sprinkle the couscous, lemon juice, parsley, and a little extra sugar over the chicken, tossing gently to combine flavors.
Garnish with additional parsley and optional toasted sesame seeds for crunch.
Serve immediately, ensuring each portion has an even distribution of chicken, couscous, and sauce.
Optional: pair with a chilled glass of dry white wine to enhance the winey notes.
